category_title: Students who are hesitant or fearful of physical challenges
scenario_title: Initial refusal at the high ropes course
minimal_context: The student is standing at the high ropes course preparing to participate in the climbing elements with peers acting as belayers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, it is time to start the high ropes course. Please step up to the first element while your classmates get ready to belay you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks up at the ropes) I don't know about this. I am sort of afraid of heights.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's time for your turn. What do you think about trying it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am really scared of falling. You have to rely on your friends to belay you, and I don't know if I can trust them to not let me fall.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just go ahead and step up to the start.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Steps back from the course) No, I’m not gonna do that.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright, it is time to start the high ropes course. Please step up to the first element while your classmates get ready to belay you.

STUDENT: (Looks up at the ropes) I don't know about this. I am sort of afraid of heights.

TUTOR: It's time for your turn. What do you think about trying it?

STUDENT: I am really scared of falling. You have to rely on your friends to belay you, and I don't know if I can trust them to not let me fall.

TUTOR: Just go ahead and step up to the start.

STUDENT: (Steps back from the course) No, I’m not gonna do that.

task.content: Participating in high ropes course elements
task.learning_goal: Challenge themselves to reach a new personal goal; could be physical, mental, something they were afraid of, emotional

context.materials: High ropes course elements, belay system, equipment
context.social_setting: Peers acting as belayers, facilitators monitoring
context.time_context: Initial arrival at the ropes course

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Looking at the ropes course elements
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Verbal refusal, stating they would not participate
related_quotes: I learned that I am really scared of falling.

behavior_patterns.condition: Engaging in challenge course activities designed to induce 'disequilibria' through physical and emotional risk
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Initial refusal followed by eventual participation in the zip line and high ropes course by the end of the day
related_quotes: I liked the zip line because it was really fun and I am sort of afraid of heights and kinda like conquered that fear.
